cold_method: detach + `purge` + reattach of a dedicated APFS disk image before every run

du.name: du (system)
du.notes: GNU coreutils on Linux, BSD du on macOS (version = OS build).

ncdu.name: ncdu (JSON export)
ncdu.notes: Non-interactive export mode (-o); includes writing the JSON export.

erdtree.name: erdtree (erd)
erdtree.notes: -i/--hidden so .gitignore'd and hidden files are counted like every other tool.

nulldisk.name: NullDisk CLI

planned_gui.name: GrandPerspective
planned_gui.reason: Accepts a folder on the command line and starts scanning, but has no auto-save/exit or completion signal. Needs Accessibility (UI scripting) to detect the finished window; GitHub macOS runners cannot grant TCC Accessibility permission non-interactively. Planned for dedicated machines.

planned_gui.name: DaisyDisk
planned_gui.reason: Commercial (trial). No CLI/AppleScript scan dictionary; would need UI automation + a licence for CI. Planned for dedicated machines with the vendor's OK.

planned_gui.name: OmniDiskSweeper
planned_gui.reason: Free, but no scripting/CLI; completion only visible in UI. Needs Accessibility automation (planned, dedicated machine).

planned_gui.name: Disk Inventory X
planned_gui.reason: Free/GPL, no CLI; UI automation needed (planned). Older builds are Intel-only.

planned_gui.name: SquirrelDisk
planned_gui.reason: Open source (Tauri) and scans by spawning pdu internally, so its engine time is approximately pdu's; GUI has no completion signal. Planned.

planned_gui.name: WizTree
planned_gui.reason: Has a proper CLI export (/export=... /admin=1, MFT scan) and would be easy to automate, but the EULA allows free use for personal use only; running it on CI for a public benchmark needs a supporter licence or the vendor's permission. Planned pending permission.

planned_gui.name: SpaceSniffer
planned_gui.reason: Documented CLI (scan <dir> export <config> <file> autoclose) was implemented, but on windows-latest the process never exits (likely a first-run/modal dialog on the headless desktop); needs UI automation or a pre-seeded config. Planned.

planned_gui.name: TreeSize Free
planned_gui.reason: Free edition exposes no scan/export command-line switches (CLI is Professional-only). Would need UI automation (pywinauto) waiting for the scan to finish. Planned.

planned_gui.name: Baobab (GNOME Disk Usage Analyzer)
planned_gui.reason: No export/exit mode; completion only in UI. Needs AT-SPI automation under Xvfb. Planned.

planned_gui.name: QDirStat
planned_gui.reason: GUI has no scan-and-exit mode; its bundled qdirstat-cache-writer is a separate Perl script, not the GUI's engine. Planned (UI automation or a --slow-update-free headless mode if upstream adds one).

planned_gui.name: dua / gdu / ncdu interactive TUIs
planned_gui.reason: Excluded: interactive mode renders to a terminal; their non-interactive modes are measured in the CLI track instead.
